type Shape = { x: number } | { y: number };
class Point implements Shape {
  x = 1;
  y = 2;
}

type Named = { name: string } & { age: number };
class Person implements Named {
  name = "Ann";
  age = 30;
}

class Count implements number {
  value = 0;
}

class Box<T> implements T {
  value = 0;
}

console.log(new Point(), new Person(), new Count(), new Box());
